extraction.notes: Whole document read. Presidency conclusions issued in the absence of consensus (supported by 26 delegations); the text speaks as 'the Council', recorded as printed. The North Macedonia paragraphs (66 to 75, pages 23-26) contain no Chapter 2 or technology content ('modernisation of its public administration' has no digital content). One horizontal passage on roaming for the Western Balkans partners is extracted. Not extracted: joining the Single Euro Payments Area (digital finance, out under R22), Moldova's cyber-attacks and 'new technological tools' (other country), Serbia's Regulatory Authority for Electronic Media (other country, media), advanced technology items in Türkiye's sanctions (other country). Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.

items.stated_text: The Western Balkans partners achieving the same goal in 2026. The Council invites the Commission to accelerate work towards this end.
items.summary: The Council looks forward to the Western Balkans partners joining the 'Roam like at home' area in 2026 and asks the Commission to speed up work.
items.extraction_note: Bullet in paragraph 10 under the lead-in 'It looks forward to, in particular:'; 'the same goal' refers to the preceding bullet, Ukraine and Moldova joining the 'Roam like at home area' (calls and mobile data without additional charges). Doubtful: roaming concerns access to mobile communications services rather than network infrastructure itself.

pass2.classification_note: theme_doubtful resolved: materiality met; roaming is named in the RI-TEC-011 definition. Concerns the Western Balkans as a group
